title: BYD Unveils PHEV Crossover With 1,430-Mile Range
summary: BYD announced its latest crossover SUV, the FCB Ti 9, which promises a combined range of 1,430 miles.

title: New Algorithm Designs Expandable 3D Lattices
summary: Researchers from Harvard and Tokyo University developed collapsible scissored surfaces and pantographic lattices inspired by origami and kirigami.

title: Generative Design Optimizes Liquid-Cooling Channels
summary: University of Michigan-Dearborn researchers published a physics-guided generative design framework for liquid cooling channel topology optimization in advanced packaging.

title: Atomica Launches AI Thermal Microstructures Platform
summary: Atomica introduced a platform combining microfluidic cooling, sensing, and wafer-level packaging for advanced AI and photonic hardware.

title: Locus Robotics Acquires Nexera Robotics
summary: Locus Robotics acquired Nexera Robotics to bolster its manipulation capabilities using soft picking technology.

title: EWR and Keir Deploy Drones for Site Clearance
summary: East West Rail deployed thermal-imaging drones in pre-construction ecological surveys to accelerate site clearance and protect wildlife.

title: 3D Systems and SRNL Partner on Additive Manufacturing
summary: 3D Systems and SRNL partnered to advance materials, AI-enabled process optimization, and workforce training for energy and national security applications.

title: Weisun Adds Single-Panel Curing and Annealing Oven
summary: Weisun added a 310mm x 310mm chamber to its AQWOL-5S range for fan-out panel level packaging lines.

title: Laser Pulses and X-Rays Reveal Micron-Scale Defect Impact
summary: Advanced imaging techniques reveal the unexpected effects of microscale material defects on heat dissipation and power management.

title: Achieving Long-Cycling Silicon Solid-State Batteries
summary: Researchers developed stress-mitigation strategies that achieve near-zero stress variation and high cycling stability in silicon-based all-solid-state batteries.

title: New Machine-Learning Framework for Protein Design
summary: A machine-learning framework was introduced to enhance computational protein design without relying on natural sequences.

title: Qualcomm Backs Open-Source AI Software to Challenge Nvidia
summary: Qualcomm leverages modular open-source AI software to separate workloads from specific silicon choices and challenge Nvidia's dominance.

title: Framework Identifies Critical Power Grid Measurement Nodes
summary: A new framework evaluates power grid sensor vulnerability to identify critical measurement nodes susceptible to false data injection attacks.

title: Evaluating Property-Specific Recoverability in Camera rPPG
summary: Researchers evaluated property-specific PPG-to-rPPG recoverability using 655 recordings, revealing that physiological properties differ in recording-specific preservation and environmental dependence.

title: Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning Benchmark for Robots
summary: This work introduces the Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning task and ESRP-Bench to evaluate agents rearranging furniture using egocentric observations.

title: SpaceX Loads Starship onto Ship in Indian Ocean
summary: SpaceX has loaded Flight 13's Starship upper stage onto a ship in the Indian Ocean for transport back to Texas.

title: Historical and Engineering Reassessment of AC Phase Order
summary: This paper reassesses why three-phase power became dominant in bulk AC transmission by analyzing power smoothness, conductor architecture, and historical factors.

title: Task-Aware Deformable Prediction for 3D Object Detection
summary: Researchers propose a task-aware deformable prediction method for single-stage 3D object detection that adapts features for different tasks.

title: Bedrock Robotics Deploys Autonomous Excavators
summary: Bedrock Robotics deploys autonomous excavators to active construction job sites to tackle labor shortages using AI-powered heavy machinery.

title: Goodfire Opens AI Interpretability Platform to Public
summary: Goodfire has released its Silico platform, offering mechanistic interpretability tools to help users peer inside and understand AI model behavior.

title: Earthquake Sensors Record Hurricane Infrasound Signals
summary: Researchers found that seismoacoustic earthquake sensors can detect infrasound and mechanical vibrations produced by turbulent hurricane winds.

title: Lane Electronics Offers Compact Connectors for UAVs
summary: Lane Electronics is supplying Weald Electronics compact LM200 connector systems designed to address the evolving unmanned aerial vehicle market.
